🆕 Newly posted (published: September 21, 2026)

Sugo-Ashi Relaxed Walk November will be held. Meet at 10:00 a.m. on November 17 (Tuesday) at the west parking lot of Hanno City Hall. Depending on weather and number of participants, you'll walk one of two courses (each roughly 7 kilometers, about 2.5 hours). Course (1) goes from City Hall via Benzaiten shrine, Chikkanji Temple, Noninji Temple, Central Park, Hanno River stepping stones bridge, Hanno Station, and Higashi-Hanno Station back to City Hall. Course (2) goes through areas in Hanno (Shimokaji, Soyagi, Kaji, etc.) and Iruma (Shinko, Noda, etc.) and returns by train from Fushiko Station. Free (participants cover their own insurance). Same-day registration. Bring water, rain gear, transportation IC card, and Sugo-Ashi handbook (if you have one). To confirm cancellation, check the Hanno Walking Club website or contact Onda (090-2205-8073) after 3:00 p.m. the day before. Organized by Hanno Walking Club.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kenkohukusibu/hokencenter/14134.html
